# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About BrightDrop
A vibrant and distinctive digital products store designed to stand out with a bright, eye-catching aesthetic. The store aims to deliver a unique shopping experience for digital goods, complete with integrated payment capabilities and full custom domain and hosting support.
